name: app-black-app-presentation-header-strip-with-logo
title: Black rounded strip with an outlined 'App presentation' pill and white logo
whatItIs: A wide black rounded panel with a thin outlined pill 'APP PRESENTATION' at the top left and a white rounded 'pilo' logo at the top right, otherwise empty.
whatItMeans: A quiet chapter opener; emptiness builds anticipation for what follows.
techniques: Use an outlined pill as a chapter label.
Place the logo opposite the label.
Leave the field empty and black.

vocabulary.definition: An outlined capsule naming a section.
A logo placed in a top corner.
